atoms.text: Doubles can be used to help solve some additions.

atoms.sound: ssml: How do we solve this addition?<break time="800ms"/> We can break it up into chunks.<break time="1000ms"/>
ssml: First, we add 4.<break time="1000ms"/> This is easier because we know how to solve additions with doubles.
ssml: Next, we add the 1 that remains.<break time="1000ms"/>This problem has the same answer because 4 plus 1 equals 5.
